[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] '''Tirossk''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] who commanded the [[Lancer (freightliner)|''Lancer'']], a [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] that was part of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] [[Rapid Response Task Force]].<ref name="LSSM" />

In [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]], Tirossk participated in the [[Battle of Mindor]]. When [[General/Legends|General]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] [[Justice (MC80 Star Cruiser)|''Justice'']] was destroyed by [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Cronal|Shadowspawn's]] [[gravity bomb]], Tirossk became the unofficial commander of the Rapid Response Task Force by virtue of his seniority.<ref name="LSSM" />
